user.title: Add panel
user.description: Set up a new HomeTiles panel.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Panel discovered
zeroconf_confirm.description: **{name}** ({model}) was found on the network at {host}. HomeTiles Bridge will send the MQTT credentials below to the panel; it will then restart. Host and port are prefilled automatically. Enter username and password if your MQTT broker requires login credentials.

data.panel_password: Panel Web Admin password (only if set)

data_description.panel_password: Leave empty if the panel has no Web Admin password. It is used only for this setup and is not stored.

discovery_confirm.title: Panel discovered
discovery_confirm.description: **{name}** announced itself over MQTT with base topic {base_topic}. Only add it if it is your panel.

adopt_confirm.title: Link panel
adopt_confirm.description: **{name}** announced itself over MQTT with base topic {base_topic}, which the entry **{entry}** uses. Only link it if it is your panel.

pairing_confirm.title: Set up encryption

link_confirm.title: Panel found
link_confirm.description:
Pair was pressed on the panel **{name}** ({model}, {host}). It connects to Home Assistant directly; no MQTT broker is needed.

After you add it, the panel and this dialog show the same six-digit number.

link_number.title: Compare the number

link_switch.title: Connect the panel
link_switch.description:
Pair was pressed on the panel **{name}** ({host}). It is already set up here and now connects to Home Assistant directly, without MQTT. Its entry, area, names and entities stay.

After you confirm, the panel and this dialog show the same six-digit number.

progress.link_wait: The panel **{name}** connects to Home Assistant. This takes a few seconds.
progress.link_finish: Now tap Confirm on the panel **{name}**.

error.topic_already_configured: A panel with this MQTT topic is already configured.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the panel. Check that it's still on the network and try again.
error.mqtt_host_required: Enter an MQTT host or IP address.
error.invalid_port: Enter a valid MQTT port between 1 and 65535.
error.invalid_panel_password: The panel rejected the Web Admin password.
error.panel_password_required: The panel's Web Admin is protected by a password. Enter the Web Admin password.
error.panel_locked: Too many wrong passwords. Wait a few minutes and try again.
error.panel_identity_failed: The device could not prove that it is the panel with this password. No credentials were sent.
error.link_unsupported: The panel's firmware cannot connect directly yet. Update the panel first.
error.link_window_closed: The panel no longer accepts the connection. Press Pair on the panel again and add it within two minutes.

abort.missing_device_id: The discovered device did not send a valid identifier.
abort.mqtt_not_configured: No MQTT integration is set up in Home Assistant. Please set up the MQTT integration first.
abort.unsupported_broker: The configured MQTT broker requires TLS or a client certificate, which the panel does not support. Please enter the broker credentials manually in the panel's web interface.
abort.mqtt_read_failed: Could not read the MQTT credentials.
abort.panel_linked: The panel was linked to the existing entry.
abort.adopt_target_changed: The entry now belongs to another panel or uses another base topic.
abort.pairing_done: Encrypted. The display now sends encrypted commands.
abort.pairing_confirmed: Confirmed. Now confirm on the display too.
abort.pairing_rejected: Rejected. The display stays connected unencrypted.
abort.pairing_expired: This attempt has ended. Tap Encrypt on the display again.
abort.link_unavailable: The connection service of the HomeTiles Bridge is not running. The Home Assistant log has the details.
abort.link_failed: The panel did not answer or the pairing was cancelled. Pair again on the panel under Settings > System > Security, or add it here once more.
abort.link_rejected: Rejected. The panel was not added.
abort.link_press_pair: Press Pair on the panel under Settings > System > Security; it then appears here.
abort.link_switched: Done. The panel is now connected directly and encrypted.

menu_options.access_codes: Codes for locks and alarm panels (all displays)

entities.title: Entity configuration
entities.description: Applies to all displays. Switchable entities: switch, input_boolean, automation, fan, humidifier, remote and siren. Automations are enabled/disabled. Scenes and scripts are started; buttons and input buttons are pressed once.

data_description.locks: Can only be operated from a paired (encrypted) display with a Web Admin password. Home Assistant checks the code, or the Bridge when one is set under “Codes for locks and alarm panels”.
data_description.alarm_panels: Can only be operated from a paired (encrypted) display with a Web Admin password. Home Assistant checks the code, or the Bridge when one is set under “Codes for locks and alarm panels”.
data_description.open_without_code: Warning: anyone at the display can unlock, open or disarm these locks and alarm panels without a code. Only for devices without their own code or with a default code.

access_codes.title: Codes for locks and alarm panels
access_codes.description: Optional. Many devices ignore a wrong code without reporting an error: Home Assistant then reports success, and the display can show neither “wrong code” nor the lockout after several wrong codes. With a code here, the Bridge checks every code from a display itself and passes only a correct one on to Home Assistant. Separate several codes with commas. Leave it empty when Home Assistant already reports a wrong code. When the code on the device changes, change it here too.

energy.title: Energy Dashboard
energy.description: Send data from the Home Assistant Energy Dashboard to devices.

error.invalid_editable_entities: Choose compatible Number, Select or Date/Time entities.
error.pairing_nothing_selected: Nothing changed. Tick the box to turn encryption off.
error.invalid_access_codes: Up to 10 codes separated by commas, each at most 32 characters.

abort.pairing_removed: Encryption turned off. The display turns it off too when it connects.
abort.pairing_not_paired: Not encrypted. To set it up, choose Settings → System → Security → Encrypt on the display.
abort.pairing_removing: Encryption is turning off. The display turns it off when it connects.
abort.no_access_entities: First select locks or alarm panels under “Entity configuration”.
